item.name: Candle
item.effect: Lights the nearby area after it is lit.
item.whereToFind: Tables, desks, and containers during a run.
item.requirement: A Lighter is needed to ignite it.
item.helpsWith: Dark rooms and entity warnings after its Rift transformation.
item.limitation: It is weak until lit and uses an inventory slot.
item.alias: Possessed Candle after a Rift transformation
item.cardSummary: A small light source that becomes more useful when paired with a Lighter or a Rift.

item.name: Flashlight
item.effect: Provides rechargeable directional light for dark rooms.
item.areas: The Hotel, The Mines, The Rooms, and The Outdoors
item.whereToFind: Containers and shops during released floor runs.
item.requirement: Batteries are needed to recharge it.
item.helpsWith: Dark rooms and spotting the route during chases.
item.limitation: The charge drains while it is on and its flicker can attract Figure.
item.cardSummary: The dependable long-range light. Keep batteries nearby and switch it off when the room is bright.

item.name: Lighter
item.effect: Provides a small temporary light and can ignite Candles.
item.areas: The Hotel and other released floors
item.whereToFind: Containers, the Pre-Run Shop, and Jeff's Shop.
item.helpsWith: Dark rooms and lighting Candles.
item.limitation: Its light radius and fuel are smaller than a Flashlight's.
item.cardSummary: A common backup light that also turns a plain Candle into a working light source.

item.name: Straplight
item.effect: Provides a small directional light while another item is held.
item.areas: The Mines and other released floors
item.whereToFind: Containers and shops during runs.
item.requirement: Batteries are needed to recharge it.
item.helpsWith: Dark rooms when you need to keep a key, tool, or consumable equipped.
item.limitation: It has a short range and uses batteries.
item.cardSummary: A hands-free light for players who do not want to swap away from their useful item.

item.name: Shakelight
item.effect: Provides directional light and can be recharged by shaking it.
item.areas: The Mines and other released floors
item.whereToFind: Containers and Jeff's Shop.
item.usesOrDuration: Short charge that refills when shaken
item.helpsWith: Dark rooms when batteries are scarce.
item.limitation: It loses charge quickly and has a small light cone.
item.cardSummary: A rechargeable light that trades range and fuel for a battery-free refill.

item.name: Glowstick
item.effect: Creates light where it is thrown and can hit Giggles.
item.areas: The Mines and other released floors
item.whereToFind: Lockers, drawers, and other containers.
item.usesOrDuration: Infinite until its light is extinguished
item.helpsWith: Small dark spaces and stunning Giggles.
item.limitation: You must throw it to light an area, and Gloombats can put it out.
item.cardSummary: A throwable light that also doubles as a handy answer to a Giggle on your back.

item.name: Bulklight
item.effect: Provides a wide directional light and can stun Giggles.
item.areas: The Mines and The Hotel after being carried through a Rift
item.whereToFind: Containers in The Mines, the Pre-Run Shop, and Jeff's Shop.
item.requirement: Batteries are needed to recharge it.
item.helpsWith: Large dark rooms and Giggles.
item.limitation: It takes an inventory slot and is mainly found in The Mines.
item.cardSummary: A stronger Flashlight with a bigger cone, built for the wide spaces in The Mines.

item.name: Laser Pointer
item.effect: Creates a small light at the player's crosshair.
item.areas: The Mines and other released floors
item.whereToFind: Lockers, toolboxes, and drawers.
item.requirement: Batteries are needed to recharge it.
item.helpsWith: Dark rooms with Gloombats and precise close-range lighting.
item.limitation: The lit area is very small.
item.cardSummary: A low-drain pointer light that is surprisingly useful when a broad beam would wake up trouble.

item.name: Moonlight Candle
item.effect: Provides a large blue light and detects certain entities.
item.areas: The Hotel and The Mines after Rift creation
item.whereToFind: Create it by placing a normal Candle in a Guiding Light Rift.
item.requirement: A Candle and a Guiding Light Rift.
item.helpsWith: Dark rooms and warnings for approaching entities.
item.limitation: It stops working in subfloors because it relies on Guiding Light.
item.cardSummary: The Rift version of Candle, with a brighter glow and an entity-warning effect.

item.name: Lantern
item.effect: Provides 360-degree light with more fuel than a Lighter.
item.whereToFind: The ground, tables, and vine-covered chests in The Outdoors. One is guaranteed before the Eyestalk chase.
item.helpsWith: The Outdoors maze and the Eyestalk chase.
item.limitation: It stops working in water and can cause problems in Firedamp rooms.
item.cardSummary: The Outdoors' wide-angle light. Grab one before the chase if your Flashlight is looking gloomy.

item.name: Batteries
item.effect: Recharge compatible electronic light sources.
item.whereToFind: Containers, drawers, tables, and other run loot.
item.requirement: A compatible light source or Battery Pack.
item.helpsWith: Flashlight, Bulklight, Straplight, and Laser Pointer charge.
item.limitation: They are consumed on use and cannot replace a missing light source.
item.cardSummary: The small pickup that keeps electronic lights alive. Store extras in a Battery Pack when possible.

item.name: Battery Pack
item.effect: Stores batteries so they can be used later in the run.
item.areas: The Mines and later released floors
item.whereToFind: Containers and Jeff's Shop.
item.requirement: Batteries to fill it.
item.helpsWith: Saving inventory space and keeping electronic lights charged.
item.limitation: It stores batteries but does not create them.
item.cardSummary: A compact battery pouch that turns loose batteries into a much easier carry.

item.name: Starlight Bottle
item.effect: Heals 50% of maximum health, grants speed, and creates a short area of light.
item.whereToFind: The final room of The Backdoor and its shop.
item.usesOrDuration: About 10 seconds of light and speed
item.helpsWith: Recovering health and gaining time during The Backdoor.
item.limitation: It is consumed after one use and the bonus health fades quickly.
item.cardSummary: A compact heal and speed boost from The Backdoor that can also create a temporary extra Rift.

item.name: Starlight Jug
item.effect: Heals 100 HP, grants a long speed boost and Star Shield, and lights the area.
item.whereToFind: Room A-1000 in The Rooms.
item.usesOrDuration: 4 uses; boost and glow last about 135 seconds
item.requirement: Reach A-1000.
item.helpsWith: Large health recovery, long chases, and carrying a strong run-saving item forward.
item.limitation: It cannot solve instant-death encounters by itself and has a finite number of uses.
item.alias: Barrel of Starlight; Jug of Starlight
item.cardSummary: The big Starlight reward from A-1000. It is slow to earn but keeps helping long after one drink.

item.name: Starlight Vial
item.effect: Provides a short speed boost, light, and extra health.
item.whereToFind: Containers and loot in The Backdoor.
item.helpsWith: Recovering from Blitz and Lookman damage and moving quickly through The Backdoor.
item.limitation: Its boost is brief and repeated uses cannot be stacked immediately.
item.cardSummary: A quick Backdoor recovery drink that trades lasting power for a fast emergency boost.

item.name: Smoothie
item.effect: Immediately restores 35 health.
item.whereToFind: Tables in Hotel basements, excluding the Courtyard basement.
item.helpsWith: Recovering small amounts of health during The Hotel.
item.limitation: It does not need to be used at full health and takes an inventory slot.
item.cardSummary: A reliable basement heal and the ingredient for a stronger Moonlight Float.

item.name: Moonlight Float
item.effect: Restores 100 HP, gives a short glow, and highlights important items and entities.
item.whereToFind: Create it by placing a Smoothie in a Guiding Light Rift.
item.usesOrDuration: About 1 minute of glow and 5 minutes of highlights
item.requirement: A Smoothie and a Guiding Light Rift.
item.helpsWith: Finding Keys, Books, Fuses, Breaker Poles, Generators, and nearby entities.
item.limitation: It stops working in subfloors and is consumed when used.
item.cardSummary: A Rift-made Smoothie that turns item hunting into a much less blurry scavenger hunt.

item.name: Gween Soda
item.effect: Regenerates 100 health and gives a fading speed boost.
item.whereToFind: Trade with or use a Crucifix on Louie.
item.usesOrDuration: About 34 seconds of healing and about 28 seconds of speed
item.requirement: A Louie trade or Crucifix interaction.
item.helpsWith: Recovering from damage while moving through The Mines.
item.limitation: It takes time to heal and is not found as ordinary container loot.
item.cardSummary: A slow but generous Mine heal that also gives you a little extra running room.

item.name: Bread
item.effect: Immediately restores 45 health.
item.whereToFind: Louie trades in The Mines and rare vine-covered chests in The Outdoors.
item.helpsWith: Healing and feeding Caws to improve Lotus Petal chances.
item.limitation: Mine access usually requires giving up another item or using a Crucifix.
item.cardSummary: A small heal with one extra trick: Bread can be fed to Caws in The Outdoors.

item.name: Cheese
item.effect: Immediately restores 45 health.
item.whereToFind: Trade with or use a Crucifix on Louie.
item.requirement: A Louie trade or Crucifix interaction.
item.helpsWith: Recovering health during The Mines.
item.limitation: It has no benefit beyond healing and is not ordinary container loot.
item.cardSummary: Bread's Mine-only cousin: same heal, different snack, same slightly odd trade route.

item.name: Donut
item.effect: Immediately restores 80 health.
item.whereToFind: The Café room in a Mid-Run Rift, opened with a Skeleton Key.
item.requirement: A Skeleton Key to enter the Café Rift room.
item.helpsWith: Large emergency healing and certain Louie trades.
item.limitation: The Café room is rare, so it is not a routine source of healing.
item.cardSummary: A rare Café find that heals a big chunk of health when the Hotel decides to be generous.

item.name: Vitamins
item.effect: Gives the player a temporary speed boost.
item.whereToFind: Containers, the Pre-Run Shop, and Jeff's Shop.
item.price: 100 Knobs for a full Pre-Run Shop stack
item.helpsWith: Seek chases, Figure, Grumbles, and fast room transitions.
item.limitation: It no longer heals and repeated uses need a short wait between them.
item.cardSummary: A pure speed item for chases and tight escapes. Save one when the hallway starts moving faster than you.

item.name: Aloe
item.effect: Regenerates 100 health over a short period.
item.whereToFind: Rarely inside or on top of containers in The Outdoors.
item.helpsWith: Recovering from damage in The Outdoors.
item.limitation: It is rare, cannot be stacked, and most Outdoors threats can still kill instantly.
item.cardSummary: A full heal hidden around The Outdoors. Useful after damage, less useful against anything that skips the health bar.

item.name: Bandages
item.effect: Instantly restores 15 health.
item.areas: Multiple released floors except The Backdoor
item.whereToFind: Commonly inside containers.
item.helpsWith: Small emergency heals after entity damage.
item.limitation: They cannot be carried for later unless stored in a Bandage Pack.
item.cardSummary: A quick 15-HP pickup that is most valuable when you have already taken a hit.

item.name: Bandage Pack
item.effect: Stores bandages that can be thrown out for later healing.
item.areas: The Mines and later released floors
item.whereToFind: Containers and Jeff's Shop in The Mines.
item.requirement: Bandages to fill it.
item.helpsWith: Saving healing for later and sharing it with teammates.
item.limitation: The pack itself does not heal until it has bandages inside.
item.cardSummary: A team-friendly health pouch that keeps loose Bandages from disappearing the moment you find them.

item.name: Green Herb
item.effect: Regenerates 5 health each time a door is opened.
item.whereToFind: The Infirmary behind the Skeleton Key door.
item.usesOrDuration: Lasts until the run ends or an entity kills the player
item.requirement: A Skeleton Key to open the Infirmary.
item.helpsWith: Recovering from chip damage across a long run.
item.limitation: It is a passive effect and does not prevent instant-death attacks.
item.cardSummary: The quiet sustain option. Find it once and let every opened door do a little healing.

item.name: Crucifix
item.effect: Banishes and immobilizes one entity before breaking.
item.whereToFind: Rare loot, Jeff's Shop, and certain trades.
item.helpsWith: Rush, Ambush, Figure, Seek, Eyes, Halt, Screech, Dupe, Giggle, Dread, Gloombats, and Grumble.
item.limitation: It does not solve every entity encounter and is consumed after use.
item.cardSummary: The emergency entity tool. Keep it for the encounter that would otherwise end the run.

item.name: Alarm Clock
item.effect: Distracts Figure when wound and placed nearby.
item.whereToFind: Guaranteed in the Door 49 reception area and another spot in the Door 50 Library.
item.requirement: Wind it before placing it.
item.helpsWith: The Library puzzle and Figure's patrol route.
item.limitation: It distracts Figure rather than defeating it.
item.cardSummary: A noisy little decoy for the Library. Wind it, place it, and let Figure investigate the wrong problem.

item.name: Hotel Key
item.effect: Unlocks the next numbered Hotel door.
item.whereToFind: Containers and room surfaces near locked doors.
item.requirement: Match the key's number to the locked door.
item.helpsWith: Normal Hotel progression.
item.limitation: A wrong numbered door or Dupe can punish a rushed choice.
item.cardSummary: The basic progression key. Check its number, then check the door before opening it.

item.name: Lockpick
item.effect: Opens most locked doors and chests and can replace a Fuse in a generator.
item.whereToFind: Containers, the Pre-Run Shop, Jeff's Shop, and some trades.
item.usesOrDuration: One use per lock or generator
item.helpsWith: Locked rooms, chests, The Electrical Room, and Mines generators.
item.limitation: It does not open every special door and disappears after use.
item.cardSummary: The flexible key substitute. It saves searches, opens loot, and can sometimes stand in for a Fuse.

item.name: Skeleton Key
item.effect: Opens Skull Locks, the Infirmary, The Rooms entrance, and The Outdoors entrance.
item.areas: The Hotel and access routes to The Rooms and The Outdoors
item.whereToFind: Jeff's Shop, rare loot, and certain trades.
item.helpsWith: Green Herb, Mid-Run Rifts, The Rooms, The Outdoors, and locked treasure.
item.limitation: It is rare, so spending it on a normal lock can waste a route-opening tool.
item.cardSummary: A rare multi-use key that opens the doors most normal keys cannot.

item.name: Electrical Room Key
item.effect: Opens the Electrical Room door at the end of The Hotel.
item.whereToFind: A shelf on the upper floor of The Electrical Room.
item.helpsWith: Accessing the Circuit Breaker puzzle and the Mines elevator.
item.limitation: Lockpicks or a Skeleton Key can replace it, and it cannot be stored in a Rift.
item.cardSummary: The last key hunt in the Hotel. Find it upstairs, then get ready for the breaker room.

item.name: Book
item.effect: Provides a number and shape clue for the Library lock code.
item.whereToFind: Shelves throughout The Library.
item.requirement: Collect it during the Library puzzle.
item.helpsWith: Decoding the Door 51 padlock.
item.limitation: Only some books contain useful digits and the book leaves the inventory after reading.
item.cardSummary: Find the marked books, record their numbers, and let the Paper tell you the order.

item.name: Paper
item.effect: Shows the shape order needed for the Library lock code.
item.whereToFind: The large desk in The Library.
item.requirement: Use it together with the numbered Books.
item.helpsWith: Solving the Door 51 padlock.
item.limitation: It disappears when the Library exit is opened.
item.cardSummary: The Library's cheat sheet, minus the cheating. Match its shapes to the numbers in the Books.

item.name: Breaker Pole
item.effect: Activates the Circuit Breaker mini-game.
item.areas: The Hotel Electrical Room at Door 100
item.whereToFind: Labyrinth halls, storage rooms, and areas near the elevator.
item.usesOrDuration: 10 poles are required for the puzzle
item.requirement: The Electrical Room must be opened first.
item.helpsWith: Powering the elevator to The Mines.
item.limitation: Each pole is single-use and Figure appears while the room is being searched.
item.cardSummary: Ten small switches stand between the Hotel and the Mines. The room is the dangerous part.

item.name: Fuse
item.effect: Powers generators that open gated rooms in The Mines.
item.whereToFind: Lockers, tables, drawers, toolboxes, and sometimes the floor near a generator.
item.requirement: Insert the needed number into the room's generator.
item.helpsWith: Mines gate and generator progression.
item.limitation: Only the room's required fuses spawn, and inserted fuses leave every player's inventory.
item.cardSummary: The Mines' version of a key: find the right number of Fuses, power the generator, and open the gate.

item.name: Backdoor Room Key
item.effect: Unlocks the next Backdoor door.
item.whereToFind: Rooms and containers during The Backdoor.
item.requirement: Match it to the next Backdoor door.
item.helpsWith: Backdoor progression and reaching its final reward room.
item.limitation: It only works for the Backdoor route.
item.cardSummary: The Backdoor's numbered key. Keep moving before Haste makes the route even less forgiving.

item.name: Iron Key
item.effect: Opens locked crypts containing Lotus Petals.
item.whereToFind: Inside or on top of containers near locked crypts.
item.helpsWith: Opening crypts and collecting Lotus Petals.
item.limitation: It does not use an inventory slot and is removed when The Outdoors ends.
item.cardSummary: The brown key for Outdoors crypts. If you find a locked grave, check nearby containers.

item.name: Shears
item.effect: Cuts vines from chests and shortcuts.
item.areas: The Hotel, The Mines, and The Outdoors
item.whereToFind: Vine-covered areas, closets, containers, and Jeff's Shop.
item.helpsWith: Vine-covered loot, secret routes, and Outdoors chests.
item.limitation: They break after their available cuts are used.
item.cardSummary: A simple tool with excellent mileage: cut vines, open better loot, and do not waste the last snip.

item.name: Compass
item.effect: Points toward the next progressive door.
item.whereToFind: Containers and cabins in The Outdoors.
item.helpsWith: The Outdoors route and Hedge Maze navigation.
item.limitation: It is not useful during the Eyestalk chase and only naturally appears in The Outdoors.
item.cardSummary: The Outdoors navigation shortcut. Follow the arrow when the forest starts offering too many wrong turns.

item.name: Multitool
item.effect: Combines the functions of a Lockpick and Shears.
item.whereToFind: Jeff's Shop in The Mines and Louie trades.
item.price: 500 Gold at Jeff's Shop in The Mines
item.helpsWith: Locked doors, locked chests, vine-covered chests, and Outdoors crypts.
item.limitation: It cannot replace a Fuse in a generator and may arrive with some durability already spent.
item.cardSummary: A two-tools-in-one upgrade for players who would rather carry one useful gadget than two.

item.name: Lotus Petal
item.effect: Combines into a Lotus when enough petals are brought to Grampy.
item.whereToFind: Containers, the ground, and locked crypts.
item.usesOrDuration: 8 needed for a Lotus; up to 20 carried
item.requirement: Collect 8 and speak with Grampy.
item.helpsWith: Creating the Lotus and its revival route.
item.limitation: It is not a normal inventory-slot item and cannot be dropped.
item.cardSummary: Collect eight glowing petals in The Outdoors and Grampy turns them into a second chance.

item.name: Lotus
item.effect: Creates a revival point near where it is planted in a floor.
item.areas: The Outdoors and floors reached after it is created
item.whereToFind: Grampy creates it after 8 Lotus Petals are collected.
item.requirement: 8 Lotus Petals and Grampy's interaction.
item.helpsWith: Recovering from death and replaying a difficult floor section.
item.limitation: It must be planted before death and does not make every encounter safe.
item.cardSummary: The Outdoors reward that lets a run bend instead of completely breaking after a death.

item.name: Rift Jar
item.effect: Breaks on impact and opens a Rift where it lands.
item.whereToFind: Create it by placing a Tip Jar in a Guiding Light Rift or receive it from Louie.
item.requirement: A Tip Jar and Guiding Light Rift, or a successful Louie trade.
item.helpsWith: Saving a rare item during a dangerous middle section of a run.
item.limitation: It is hard to obtain and only one can be carried.
item.cardSummary: A throwable emergency Rift for players who do not want to carry a rare item through danger.

item.name: Tip Jar
item.effect: Transforms into a Rift Jar when placed in a Guiding Light Rift.
item.whereToFind: The Abandoned Shop room in a Mid-Run Rift or a trade with Louie.
item.requirement: A Guiding Light Rift to turn it into a Rift Jar.
item.helpsWith: Creating a portable Rift during a run.
item.limitation: It is rare and is not normal drawer loot.
item.cardSummary: A released but rare jar from the Abandoned Shop or Louie. Its real job is becoming a Rift Jar.

item.name: Glitch Fragment
item.effect: Triggers a Glitched Entity encounter that can grant a random positive buff.
item.whereToFind: Rarely inside or on top of containers, with better odds after Glitch encounters.
item.requirement: Interact with the Fragment and survive the encounter.
item.helpsWith: Rare buffs, item refills, and unusual run recovery.
item.limitation: It is extremely rare, disappears on interaction, and is not available in every special mode.
item.cardSummary: A risky mystery pickup: use it only after you have a hiding spot and a plan for the glitchy visitor.
